comparison.objective: Candidate depins a connector terminal; record carries a carton whose bottom must be supported and places it on a shelf.
comparison.physical_skill: Recessed blade insertion plus coupled pull versus continuous bimanual underside support during transport and release onto support.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires one undamaged terminal out and no unintended release; exact force/damage thresholds are missing. Record requires shelf placement with every can retained, carton upright, and grippers released.
comparison.reason: No meaningful overlap beyond bimanual control.
